messages.subject: rhdfs 1.0.8 released
parts:
Hi everyone,
we just released rhdfs 1.0.8 which addresses some compatibility issues with future versions of hadoop (namely 3.0.0). Why bother? Because we have some users that are already testing that far ahead. For everyone else, no need to upgrade from 1.0.7.


Antonio
